messages.name: anything
messages.digest: Message or list to append to
messages.description: The incoming message or list will be appended by the message stored in, preceded by a space, and the combined message is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: will causeto output the message which was most recently stored in memory (is particularly useful for triggering output following themessage).

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Message or list to append to
messages.description: The incoming floating-point value(s) will be appended by the message stored in, preceded by a space, and the combined message is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Message or list to append to
messages.description: The incoming integer value(s) will be appended by the message stored in, preceded by a space, and the combined message is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Message or list to append to
messages.description: The incoming list values will be appended by the message stored in, preceded by a space, and the combined message is sent out the outlet.

messages.description: The word, followed by any message, will replace the message stored in, without triggering output.
